# Spy film titles — Style Prompt

> A cut-paper, four-ink title sequence: silhouettes move through sets built out of the credits themselves, every cut lands on a beat, and the title is assembled from flying pieces. Flat opaque inks, scissor-cut edges, small paper shadows, a faint grain.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

- **Flat, opaque inks on paper.** Four colours, no gradients: ink black, paper cream, a hot red, a warm mustard.
- **Hand-cut edges** on every shape. Pieces sit in layers with a thin cut gap and a small paper shadow.
- **Abstraction down to silhouettes.** Figures in profile; acting is outline and timing.
- **Type is the picture's structure.** Credits are architecture, props and roads.
- **Every cut is an edit point.** A title sequence is a tiny story: one goal, a few locations, one reveal.

Not flat vector motion graphics (the edges are cut, the paper is physical), not a halftone print look, not a Swiss grid, not a parody with gadgets. Suits any "mission" told in a minute: a launch, a reveal, a hunt, a teaser.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Scissor edges.** Every polygon is resampled every ~9 px and displaced along its normal by low-frequency noise (amplitude ~1.3 px, plus a rare small nick). Cut each shape once in its own local space and keep it, so a moving piece keeps its edge instead of crawling.
- **Layering.** Pieces separate by a ~4.5 px gap in the ground colour and a soft offset shadow (about 3 px right, 4 px down, 30% black). A whole figure gets one outline around the merged silhouette, never an outline per piece.
- **Paper texture.** One full-frame speckle layer drawn once: light specks that show on ink, dark specks and short fibres that show on paper, at about 50% opacity.
- **Silhouettes.** About seven heads tall, identity by hat, coat cut and shoes, one colour accent (a tie) that streams back when running. Wedge hands, a single eye slit at most.
- **The object of the chase** sits on a black backing so it reads on any ground; it is the brightest thing in frame.
- **Letters** are re-cut: edge displacement by a static filter, ±0.8° rotation, ±1.5 px baseline jitter.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` is ink black (the cold open and the final ground). `--utama` is the hot red: the keyhole, the grid ground, the band, the accent tie. `--aksen` is mustard: the object and the street ground. `--teks` is paper, mixed into `--kertas` for the chase ground; `--tinta` is `--latar`.
- One dominant ground per scene, changing per location. Text sits on its own surface token: `--teks-di-utama` on red, `--teks-di-aksen` on mustard.
- Background props use a darker version of the ground, never black, or they read as letters.
- Fixed regardless of brand: flat fills only, the shadow and the gap around pieces.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul`: a condensed display face (Oswald 700). Credits 230–400 px at 1920 wide, 0.05em tracking, uppercase; the small lead-in line 64 px at 0.22em.
- `--font-isi`: a geometric heavy sans (Poppins 800), 44 px on a paper strip that is cut at both ends and tilted -1.2°.
- Credits live in the set, one line per location, fully readable at some moment. Fictional roles only.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Puppets on twos (12 fps):** legs and arms swing ±44–50° with `steps(3)` every 0.2 s (one step per beat), the tie flutters ±5°.
- **Camera and grid growth on ones (24–30 fps):** `steps(24–72)` over the move; a stepped camera judders, a smooth one reads as video.
- Credits slide or slap and **stop dead** (`power2/4.out`, 0.12–0.2 s); letters land with a paper slap (−40 px, scale 1.18 → 1) staggered 0.03–0.05 s.
- Strips slide in from the left in 0.18 s and hold ≥ 1.8 s.
- **Stop-time:** everything freezes for ~0.6 s on a stab. Cuts are hard, never dissolves. The ending holds still ≥ 2 s.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Locked single shape on a flat ground | mystery, an icon | a cold open; a clue; a logo |
| Slow push on ones | tension | a reveal; a countdown |
| Lateral tracking in one direction | pursuit; momentum | a chase; a delivery; a hunt |
| Hard cut on a beat | punch; a new location | a montage; a gag |
| Truck in along a word | reading, then action | a list; a roster |
| Diagonal split into a grid | fragmentation | a team; a conspiracy |

Framing: strong ~30° diagonals, big flat grounds, small figures against big type.

## 7. Native moves

- **Type is the set.** Each location is one line of credits that is its architecture. *Fits content like:* a conference programme as a city; a menu as a street; team names as a stadium; a hunt route as a road of letters.
- **The slit that opens.** A thin line widens into the central shape. *Fits content like:* a product reveal; a lesson's key idea; a story's first clue.
- **Silhouette chase.** A profile runs on twos after the object. *Fits content like:* a courier on a deadline; a launch countdown; a game's mission.
- **Stop-time gag.** Freeze on a stab, then resume. *Fits content like:* a near miss; a price reveal; a plot twist.
- **The object becomes the title.** The thing everyone pursues is the last piece to land. *Fits content like:* a product launch; an event name; a book title.
- **The diagonal grid.** Cut lines multiply, later pieces fly back along them to assemble. *Fits content like:* a puzzle solved; a team forming; a logo assembled.

## 8. Pitfalls

- Outlining every internal piece looks like a mannequin diagram: merge pieces, outline the whole.
- Black background props read as letters: use a darker ground colour.
- An object in the same ink as its ground vanishes: give it a black backing.
- A credit seen only in part is uncomfortable: open wide on the full line, then truck.
- A stiff streamer reads as a tongue: let it flutter.
- Box text must fit its strip; never clip.

# Spy film titles: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.6, medium 2.6, long 3.4.

## hook

- en: one flat shape on a black ground opens from a thin red slit; a torn paper strip slides in; camera creeps on ones
- id: satu bentuk datar di alas hitam membuka dari celah merah tipis; secarik kertas teks masuk; kamera merayap per gambar

## problem

- en: a figure runs on twos toward the object across a diagonal band; hard cut on the beat, then stop-time freeze
- id: siluet berlari per dua gambar mengejar benda melewati pita diagonal; potong keras di ketukan, lalu beku sejenak

## fact

- en: a diagonal cut grid grows over a red ground and the credit slaps in letter by letter on two staggered lines
- id: kisi potongan diagonal tumbuh di alas merah, kredit menampar masuk huruf demi huruf di dua baris menjorok

## step

- en: one location per step: a silhouette crosses it, the camera trucks sideways on ones, a strip names the stop
- id: satu lokasi tiap langkah: siluet melintas, kamera menyusur ke samping per gambar, secarik kertas menyebut pos

## compare

- en: the frame splits on a ~30 degree diagonal, each half its own ground colour, a figure on each side
- id: layar terbelah diagonal ~30 derajat, tiap sisi beralas warna sendiri, satu siluet di tiap sisi

## number

- en: the figure is spelled in giant cut letters standing on a road; small agents walk between them, a sign drops on two cords
- id: angka dieja huruf potong raksasa di atas jalan; agen kecil berjalan di antara huruf, papan turun di dua tali

## proof

- en: a standing silhouette in full frontal on the diagonal band holds the object, held in stop-time silence
- id: siluet berdiri tegak menghadap depan di pita diagonal memegang benda, ditahan diam seperti waktu berhenti

## offer

- en: the offer is the last piece: letters of the deal fly in along the diagonal and lock in on a stab
- id: tawaran jadi potongan terakhir: huruf tawaran terbang menyusur diagonal dan terkunci di satu pukulan

## cta

- en: title pieces fly in on the diagonal and assemble, the object lands last, then a paper strip with date and contact holds 2 s
- id: potongan judul terbang menyusur diagonal dan tersusun, bendanya mendarat terakhir, secarik kertas tanggal dan kontak ditahan 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the object lands on the assembled title and everything freezes: a stop-time button held 2 s
- id: benda mendarat di judul yang sudah tersusun lalu semua membeku: penutup waktu berhenti ditahan 2 detik

<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1920, height=1080" />
    <title>Pembuka film mata-mata</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Oswald"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #1b1714; --latar-2: #2b241e; --utama: #d23a22; --aksen: #e2a52a;
        --teks: #efe4c9; --teks-redup: #b8ab8e; --teks-di-utama: #efe4c9; --teks-di-aksen: #1b1714;
        --utama-di-latar: #e0543a; --aksen-di-latar: #e2a52a;
        --font-judul: "Oswald", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Poppins", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Kertas dan tinta dicampur dari token, jadi dunia ikut brand. */
        --kertas: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 94%, var(--latar)); --tinta: var(--latar); --sombra: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 40%, black);
      }
      * {margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
      html, body {width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--latar);}
      #root {position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--latar);}
      .sc, .cam, svg.isi, #tekstur {position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1920px;height:1080px;}
      .sc {visibility:hidden;background:var(--fond);}
      svg {overflow:visible;} #tekstur {pointer-events:none;opacity:0.5;}
      /* Tiap adegan menamai alas dan tintanya sendiri. */
      #s1 {--fond:var(--latar);visibility:visible;} #s2 {--fond:var(--utama);} #s3 {--fond:var(--kertas);} #s4 {--fond:var(--aksen);} #s5 {--fond:var(--latar);}
      .acc {fill:var(--tie, var(--utama));}
      /* Huruf: dipotong ulang, miring sedikit, tepi digeser filter statis. */
      .g {display:inline-block;white-space:pre;filter:url(#potong);}
      .row {position:absolute;white-space:nowrap;font:700 200px/1 var(--font-judul);letter-spacing:0.05em;}
      .kecil {position:absolute;white-space:nowrap;font:700 64px/1 var(--font-judul);letter-spacing:0.22em;}
      /* Secarik kertas teks: ujung digunting, sedikit miring. */
      .strip {position:absolute;left:70px;top:900px;padding:16px 46px 18px 40px;transform:rotate(-1.2deg);white-space:nowrap;font:800 44px/1.1 var(--font-isi);background:var(--latar);color:var(--teks);}
      .strip::before {content:"";display:inline-block;width:14px;height:26px;margin-right:18px;vertical-align:-3px;background:var(--utama);clip-path:polygon(50% 0, 100% 22%, 100% 44%, 78% 58%, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 22% 58%, 0 44%, 0 22%);}
      #s1 .strip {background:var(--teks);color:var(--latar);}
      #tanda {position:absolute;left:1330px;top:190px;white-space:nowrap;padding:14px 30px;font:700 54px/1 var(--font-judul);letter-spacing:0.1em;background:var(--latar);color:var(--teks);}
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <!-- Bahan bersama: filter potong, pustaka figur (siluet profil dan depan). -->
      <svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute"><defs id="defs">
        <filter id="potong" x="-3%" y="-3%" width="106%" height="106%"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.045" numOctaves="2" seed="4" /><feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" scale="5" /></filter>
      </defs></svg>

      <!-- Adegan 1, hook: garis merah membuka jadi lubang kunci di alas tinta, secarik teks masuk dari kiri. -->
      <div class="sc" id="s1" data-role="hook"><div class="cam" id="c1">
        <svg class="isi" id="v1"><clipPath id="slit"><rect id="sr" x="957" y="260" width="6" height="540" /></clipPath><g id="kh" clip-path="url(#slit)"></g></svg>
        <p class="strip" id="t1">Satu peti karun, tujuh kunci.</p>
      </div></div>

      <!-- Adegan 2, fact: kisi diagonal merah tumbuh, kredit dipotong menampar masuk huruf demi huruf. -->
      <div class="sc" id="s2" data-role="fact"><div class="cam" id="c2">
        <svg class="isi" id="v2"></svg>
        <div class="kecil" id="k2" style="left:300px;top:228px;color:var(--teks-di-utama)"></div>
        <div class="row" id="r2a" style="left:240px;top:330px;color:var(--teks-di-utama)"></div>
        <div class="row" id="r2b" style="left:330px;top:540px;color:var(--teks-di-utama)"></div>
        <p class="strip" id="t2">Tiap pos memegang satu gigi kunci.</p>
      </div></div>

      <!-- Adegan 3, step: siluet berlari mengejar kunci melewati pita merah; berhenti sekejap, lalu berdiri. -->
      <div class="sc" id="s3" data-role="step"><div class="cam" id="c3">
        <svg class="isi" id="v3"></svg>
        <p class="strip" id="t3">Pos pertama: Pasar Lama.</p>
      </div></div>

      <!-- Adegan 4, number: tulisan adalah set; dua agen berjalan di jalan antara huruf, kamera menyusur. -->
      <div class="sc" id="s4" data-role="number"><div class="cam" id="c4">
        <svg class="isi" id="v4"></svg>
        <div class="row" id="r4" style="left:80px;top:419px;font-size:400px;color:var(--teks-di-aksen)"></div>
        <svg class="isi" id="w4"></svg>
        <div id="tanda">POS 1 · PASAR LAMA</div>
      </div></div>

      <!-- Adegan 5, cta: potongan judul terbang menyusur diagonal dan tersusun; kunci jadi potongan terakhir. -->
      <div class="sc" id="s5" data-role="cta"><div class="cam" id="c5">
        <svg class="isi" id="v5"></svg>
        <div class="row" id="r5a" style="left:150px;top:60px;font-size:230px;color:var(--teks)"></div>
        <div class="row" id="r5b" style="left:150px;top:290px;font-size:230px;color:var(--utama-di-latar)"></div>
        <div class="row" id="r5c" style="left:150px;top:520px;font-size:230px;color:var(--teks)"></div>
        <p class="strip" id="t5" style="top:900px">Sabtu 16 Nov · Kota Tua · Chat 0812-3456-7890</p>
      </div></div>
      <img id="tekstur" />
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
      let sd = 7;
      const rnd = () => (sd = (sd * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
      const tab = Array.from({ length: 256 }, rnd);
      const vn = (x) => { const i = Math.floor(x), f = x - i, u = f * f * (3 - 2 * f); return tab[i & 255] + (tab[(i + 1) & 255] - tab[i & 255]) * u; };
      const mk = (tag, at, parent) => { const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag); for (const k in at) e.setAttribute(k, at[k]); if (parent) parent.appendChild(e); return e; };
      const dOf = (p, close = true) => "M" + p.map((q) => q[0].toFixed(1) + " " + q[1].toFixed(1)).join("L") + (close ? "Z" : "");

      // Tepi gunting: titik di sepanjang kontur digeser derau frekuensi rendah, kadang ada takik. Dipotong sekali di koordinat lokal.
      function rough(pts, seed = 1, amp = 1.4, step = 9, closed = true) {
        const n = pts.length, out = [], E = closed ? n : n - 1;
        let s = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < E; i++) {
          const a = pts[i], b = pts[(i + 1) % n], dx = b[0] - a[0], dy = b[1] - a[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1e-6;
          const nx = -dy / L, ny = dx / L, k = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / step));
          for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) {
            const ss = s + (j / k) * L, w = j === 0 ? 0.25 : 1;
            let o = (vn(ss / (step * 2.3) + seed * 17.1) * 2 - 1) * amp * w + (vn(ss / (step * 0.55) + seed * 5.7) * 2 - 1) * amp * 0.35 * w;
            if (tab[Math.floor(ss / (step * 3) + seed * 9) & 255] > 0.965 && j > 0) o -= amp * 1.6;
            out.push([a[0] + dx * (j / k) + nx * o, a[1] + dy * (j / k) + ny * o]);
          }
          s += L;
        }
        if (!closed) out.push(pts[n - 1]);
        return out;
      }
      const circ = (cx, cy, r, n = 36) => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => [cx + Math.cos((i / n) * 6.283) * r, cy + Math.sin((i / n) * 6.283) * r]);
      const piece = (parent, pts, seed, style = "", cls = "") => mk("path", { d: dOf(rough(pts, seed)), style, class: cls }, parent);

      // Figur siluet: potongan bergabung jadi satu garis luar, lengan dan kaki berayun dari sendi.
      function build(id) {
        const g = mk("g", { id }, $("#defs")), h = {};
        const P = (key, pts, seed, pv = [0, 0], cls = "") => {
          const w = mk("g", { transform: `translate(${pv})` }, g);
          mk("path", { d: dOf(rough(pts.map((q) => [q[0] - pv[0], q[1] - pv[1]]), seed, 1.3, 9)), class: cls }, w);
          h[key] = w; h[key + "Pv"] = pv;
        };
        P("ab", [[-12, -190], [14, -190], [10, -90], [70, -40], [96, -52], [110, -38], [84, -14], [-4, -64]], 2, [4, -190]);
        P("lb", [[-18, 0], [22, 0], [18, 130], [8, 262], [50, 272], [54, 288], [-10, 288], [-6, 130]], 3);
        P("tie", [[22, -196], [34, -194], [-40, -168], [-120, -146], [-122, -166], [-40, -184]], 4, [22, -196], "acc");
        P("co", [[-30, -202], [34, -202], [40, -120], [54, 74], [-60, 74], [-40, -60]], 5);
        P("ne", [[-4, -228], [26, -228], [24, -196], [-6, -196]], 6);
        P("he", circ(14, -264, 38, 24), 7);
        P("no", [[44, -274], [70, -252], [44, -242]], 12);
        mk("path", { d: dOf(rough([[36, -266], [52, -266], [52, -261], [36, -261]], 8, 0.3, 6)), style: "fill: var(--fond)" }, g);
        P("hat", [[-36, -296], [74, -296], [74, -284], [-36, -284], [-14, -292], [-8, -340], [42, -340], [48, -292]], 9);
        P("lf", [[-18, 0], [22, 0], [18, 130], [8, 262], [50, 272], [54, 288], [-10, 288], [-6, 130]], 10);
        P("af", [[-12, -190], [14, -190], [10, -90], [70, -40], [96, -52], [110, -38], [84, -14], [-4, -64]], 11, [4, -190]);
        return h;
      }
      // Berayun tahap-dua (12 gambar per detik): proksi yang menulis transform, tahan seek.
      function swing(el, pv, a0, a1, t, dur, rep, ease = "steps(3)") {
        const o = { a: a0 }, f = () => el.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${pv}) rotate(${o.a})`);
        f();
        tl.to(o, { a: a1, duration: dur, repeat: rep, yoyo: true, ease, onUpdate: f }, t);
      }
      function gait(h, t, rep, dur = 0.2, k = 1) {
        swing(h.lf, h.lfPv, 44 * k, -44 * k, t, dur, rep); swing(h.lb, h.lbPv, -44 * k, 44 * k, t, dur, rep);
        swing(h.af, h.afPv, -50 * k, 50 * k, t, dur, rep); swing(h.ab, h.abPv, 50 * k, -50 * k, t, dur, rep);
        swing(h.tie, h.tiePv, -5, 6, t, 0.11, rep * 2 + 1, "sine.inOut");
      }
      // Satu penempatan: bayangan kertas, lingkar celah, lalu tinta penuh. Warna dasi ikut alas.
      function place(parent, href, tf) {
        const w = mk("g", {}, parent), inner = mk("g", { transform: tf }, w), u = (st) => { return mk("use", { href: "#" + href, style: st }, inner); };
        u("fill:var(--sombra);opacity:0.3;--tie:var(--sombra)").setAttribute("transform", "translate(3 4)");
        u("fill:var(--fond);stroke:var(--fond);stroke-width:9;stroke-linejoin:round;--tie:var(--fond)");
        u("fill:var(--tinta)");
        return w;
      }
      // Huruf: dipotong ulang, miring dan turun-naik sedikit (dasar tidak rata).
      function word(el, text) {
        return [...text].map((c) => {
          const s = document.createElement("span"); s.className = "g"; s.textContent = c; el.appendChild(s);
          gsap.set(s, { rotation: (rnd() - 0.5) * 1.6, y: (rnd() - 0.5) * 3 }); return s;
        });
      }
      // Ujung secarik kertas digunting: poligon persen dari kontur persegi.
      function snip(el, seed) {
        const p = rough([[0, 0], [100, 0], [100, 100], [0, 100]], seed, 2.4, 14);
        el.style.clipPath = "polygon(" + p.map((q) => q[0].toFixed(1) + "% " + q[1].toFixed(1) + "%").join(",") + ")";
      }

      // Lubang kunci dan kunci (objek kejaran, di atas alas hitam supaya terbaca di alas apa pun).
            function keyhole() {
        const g = $("#kh");
        piece(g, circ(960, 400, 92, 40), 21, "fill: var(--utama)");
        piece(g, [[926, 460], [994, 460], [1034, 760], [886, 760]], 22, "fill: var(--utama)");
      }
      function key(parent, tf) {
        const out = mk("g", {}, parent), g = mk("g", { transform: tf }, out);
        const shape = (st, seed) => {
          const bow = mk("path", { d: dOf(rough(circ(0, 0, 50, 30), seed, 1.2)) + dOf(circ(0, 0, 17, 16).reverse()), "fill-rule": "evenodd", style: st }, g);
          mk("path", { d: dOf(rough([[44, -10], [250, -10], [250, 34], [226, 34], [226, 10], [196, 10], [196, 46], [168, 46], [168, 10], [44, 10]], seed + 1, 1.2)), style: st }, g);
        };
        shape("fill:var(--tinta);stroke:var(--tinta);stroke-width:16;stroke-linejoin:round", 31);
        shape("fill:var(--aksen)", 31);
        return out;
      }
      // Kisi diagonal: dua keluarga garis terpotong tangan, tumbuh lewat dash.
      function grid() {
        const g = mk("g", { style: "fill:none;stroke:var(--latar);stroke-width:3.6;stroke-linecap:round" }, $("#v2")), out = [];
        const fam = (n, x0, y0, dx, dy, ang, len, sx) => {
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const ax = x0 + i * dx, ay = y0 + i * dy, c = Math.cos(ang), s = Math.sin(ang);
            const pts = [[ax, ay], [ax + c * len, ay + s * len]];
            out.push(mk("path", { d: dOf(rough(pts, 40 + i + sx, 1.6, 10, false), false), pathLength: 1, "stroke-dasharray": "1 1" }, g));
          }
        };
        fam(15, -500, 1200, 170, 0, -1.08, 2500, 0); fam(10, -300, -300, 0, 190, 0.3, 2700, 50);
        return out;
      }

      // ===== Bahan: tekstur kertas sekali gambar (bintik terang di tinta, gelap di kertas), jadi satu gambar =====
      (function texture() {
